summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K attaching a September 8, 2026 press release providing weekly progress on its €1.0 billion share buyback programme announced 30 April 2026. During the week of 31 August–4 September 2026, ING repurchased 1,360,000 shares at an average price of €31.01 for a total of €42,167,466, bringing cumulative repurchases to 24,930,805 shares at an average price of €27.76, totalling €692,010,672.99, roughly 69.2% complete. The programme reduces share capital. What to watch: pace of remaining buybacks and any future capital return announcements.
